description: This file appears to be a markdown documentation source describing the PageAssertions class, its methods, properties, and usage examples within the Playwright testing framework. It includes code snippets in multiple programming languages demonstrating how to use assertions on the Page object in tests.

classes.name: PageAssertions
classes.description: A class providing assertion methods to verify the state of a Page object in Playwright tests.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Makes the assertion check for the opposite condition, e.g., verifying that a condition is not true.

methods.name: NotToHaveTitle
methods.description: Asserts that the page does not have a specific title or matches a RegExp.

methods.name: NotToHaveURL
methods.description: Asserts that the page does not have a specific URL or does not match a RegExp.

options.name: ignoreCase
options.description: Whether to ignore case when matching URLs.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshot
methods.description: Waits until two consecutive screenshots are the same and compares the last screenshot with the expectation. Supports multiple overloads with options.

options.name: animations
options.description: Disable or enable animations during screenshot.

options.name: maxDiffPixels
options.description: Maximum number of different pixels allowed.

options.name: maxDiffPixelRatio
options.description: Maximum ratio of different pixels allowed.

methods.name: toHaveTitle
methods.description: Ensures that the page has the specified title or matches a RegExp.

methods.name: toHaveURL
methods.description: Ensures that the page URL matches the expected URL, RegExp, or satisfies a predicate.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Expected URL, RegExp, or predicate function.
